Task: Fix server URL in capacitor.config.ts - remove Lovable hosting URL
Details: DONE - Removed server.url and server.cleartext from capacitor.config.ts. App now loads from bundled /dist assets. Run npm run build && npx cap sync android before next Android release.

Task: Run npx cap sync after every build
Details: Before every Android or iOS release: npm run build && npx cap sync. Copies latest web assets into native projects.

Task: Update Play Store listing with new screenshots and description
Details: Log into Google Play Console. Update store listing description, screenshots (1080x1920px), and feature graphic (1024x500px).

Task: Set up Google Play Internal Testing for beta
Details: Play Console > Testing > Internal Testing. Upload .aab file. Add tester Gmail addresses (up to 100). They get an opt-in link - no review needed.

Task: Check Capacitor version (v8.3.0 - currently up to date)
Details: v8.3.0 is current as of mid-2025. No update needed. To update later: npm update @capacitor/core @capacitor/ios @capacitor/android @capacitor/cli && npx cap sync

Task: Create Apple Developer Account
Details: Cost: USD $99/year. Go to developer.apple.com/enroll. Sign in with Apple ID. Choose Individual account. Pay by card - usually approved instantly.

Task: Choose build method: Mac or Codemagic
Details: Option A: If you have a Mac - install Xcode free from Mac App Store. Option B: No Mac - use Codemagic CI/CD (free 500 min/month on M2 Mac). Recommended for solo founder.

Task: Register Bundle ID: nz.co.mindcast.signal
Details: developer.apple.com/account/resources/identifiers/list > + > App IDs > App. Bundle ID: nz.co.mindcast.signal. Enable Push Notifications capability.

Task: Create App Store Connect listing
Details: appstoreconnect.apple.com > My Apps > +. Name: Signal. Subtitle: Women's Health & Wellbeing. Bundle ID: nz.co.mindcast.signal. SKU: signal-nz-001.

Task: Add iOS platform to Capacitor
Details: Requires Mac or Codemagic. Run: npm run build, npx cap add ios, npx cap sync ios, npx cap open ios (opens Xcode). appId is already set in capacitor.config.ts.

Task: Prepare iOS App Store screenshots
Details: Required: iPhone 6.7 inch (1290x2796px) and 6.5 inch (1242x2688px), minimum 3 screenshots each. Create in Canva at exact dimensions. Show: dashboard, cycle, nutrition, journal, habits.

Task: Decision: Apple IAP vs web-only subscriptions
Details: Apple requires IAP for in-app subscriptions and takes 30% cut. Web-first model (users subscribe on your website then log in on app) avoids this. Strongly recommended for solo founder.

Task: Write App Store keywords
Details: Keywords field (100 chars max, no spaces after commas): cycle tracking,hormone health,period tracker,nervous system,womens wellness,habit tracker,menopause,NZ

Task: Add health disclaimer to app onboarding
Details: DONE - Added medical disclaimer to OnboardingFlow.tsx step 0 (welcome screen): Signal provides wellness information for educational purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

Task: Set up TestFlight for iOS beta
Details: App Store Connect > Your App > TestFlight. Internal Testing: up to 100 testers added by Apple ID, no review. External Testing: up to 10000 testers via public link, needs 24-48hr Apple review.

Task: Submit app for App Store review
Details: In Xcode: Archive > upload to App Store Connect. Then in App Store Connect select build and Submit for Review. Review takes 24-48 hours. Health apps may get extra scrutiny.

Task: Add VITE_SENTRY_DSN to production environment
Details: Sentry is already configured in src/instrument.ts. Create free account at sentry.io, create React project, copy DSN. Add VITE_SENTRY_DSN to .env and Vercel environment variables.

Task: Verify Sentry is receiving errors
Details: After adding DSN: deploy to production, cause an intentional error (visit a broken URL), then confirm it appears in your Sentry dashboard. Free tier: 5000 errors/month.

Task: Set up UptimeRobot to monitor app URL
Details: Free uptime monitoring with email alerts. Create account > Add Monitor > HTTPS > enter your production URL > 5 minute interval. Also monitor your Supabase URL separately.

Task: Set up Supabase database backups
Details: Supabase Dashboard > Settings > Backups. Verify PITR is enabled. Free plan: daily backups for 7 days. Consider Pro plan ($25/month) for better retention before you have real users.

Task: Fix PostHog hardcoded token - use env var only
Details: DONE - Removed hardcoded fallback token from src/lib/analytics.ts. PostHog now reads from VITE_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN only. Add this to your Vercel environment variables and .env file.

Task: Verify RESEND_API_KEY is set in Supabase secrets
Details: Supabase Dashboard > Settings > Edge Function Secrets. Confirm RESEND_API_KEY is present. If missing, get it from resend.com > API Keys. FROM address: support@mindcast.co.nz

Task: Verify Resend domain authentication (DKIM/SPF)
Details: Go to resend.com > Domains. Confirm mindcast.co.nz has DKIM and SPF verified (green tick). Without this, emails go to spam. Resend shows DNS records to add to your domain registrar.

Task: Test Welcome email end-to-end
Details: Create new account on production using a Gmail address. Should receive welcome email within 3 minutes. Check subject line, links work, and email renders on mobile.

Task: Test Subscription Confirmed email
Details: Subscribe to Rooted tier on production using Stripe test card 4242 4242 4242 4242. Should receive subscription confirmed email. Verify tier name displays correctly.

Task: Verify all 6 email templates render correctly
Details: 6 templates in supabase/functions/send-email/templates.ts: Welcome, Subscription Confirmed, Top-up, Renewal, Plan Changed, Cancellation. Test each by triggering the real event.

Task: Customise Supabase password reset email
Details: DONE - Branded HTML template created at supabase/email-templates/password-reset.html. Paste the HTML into: Supabase Dashboard > Auth > Email Templates > Reset Password. Uses Signal brand colours.

Task: Test Stripe webhook is registered and firing
Details: Stripe Dashboard > Developers > Webhooks. Confirm endpoint: https://hwcgbcfqxzzhvizcdroh.supabase.co/functions/v1/stripe-webhook. Check recent attempts show 200 status.

Task: Test complete checkout flow for each tier
Details: Test Rooted, Nourished, Thriving in Stripe test mode (card: 4242 4242 4242 4242). After each: verify ai_credits updates in Supabase, tier shows in Account page, features unlock.

Task: Test Stripe Customer Portal (upgrade/downgrade/cancel)
Details: From Account page click Manage Subscription. Should open Stripe Customer Portal. Test: upgrade Rooted to Nourished, downgrade, and cancel. Verify Supabase tier updates after each.

Task: Create Stripe coupon: SIGNAL1MONTH
Details: Stripe Dashboard > Coupons > + New. Code: SIGNAL1MONTH. Discount: 100% off. Duration: once (first invoice only). Single use per customer. For beta testers.

Task: Create Stripe coupon: FOUNDER50
Details: Stripe Dashboard > Coupons > + New. Code: FOUNDER50. Discount: 50% off. Duration: forever (every invoice). For advocates and early supporters.

Task: Create Stripe coupon: BETA2025
Details: Stripe Dashboard > Coupons > + New. Code: BETA2025. Discount: 100% off. Duration: repeating for 3 months. For press and influencer gifting.

Task: Verify annual pricing plans are set up
Details: Stripe Dashboard > Products > each product > Add another price. Create yearly price at roughly 10 months cost (2 months free). Helps with LTV.

Task: Protect /admin route with admin role check
Details: DONE - Admin page already protected via user_roles table query. Redirects to /auth if not logged in, redirects to / if not admin. Admin role migration file created.

Task: Block /brand route in production
Details: DONE - Added production check in BrandGuidelines.tsx: if (import.meta.env.PROD) return Navigate to /. Deploy to verify.

Task: Block /animation-poc route in production
Details: DONE - Added production check in AnimationPOC.tsx: if (import.meta.env.PROD) return Navigate to /. Deploy to verify.

Task: Set admin role for grantashl1@gmail.com
Details: Run in Supabase SQL Editor: INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role) SELECT id, 'admin'::public.app_role FROM auth.users WHERE email IN ('grantashl1@gmail.com','admin@mindcast.co.nz') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; The auto_grant_admin_role trigger handles future signups.

Task: Invite admin@mindcast.co.nz and grant admin role
Details: Supabase Dashboard > Auth > Users > Invite User > admin@mindcast.co.nz. Sends a password setup email. The auto_grant_admin_role trigger grants admin access on signup.

Task: Run Supabase Security Advisor
Details: Supabase Dashboard > Advisors > Security. Lists tables with missing RLS, exposed functions, or security warnings. Fix all critical and high severity items before launch.

Task: Verify RLS on all user data tables
Details: Check RLS is enabled on: profiles, journal_entries, cycle_logs, workout_logs, habit_completions, nutrition_plans, community_posts. Supabase Dashboard > Table Editor > each table > RLS tab.

Task: Gate Connect course behind Nourished tier
Details: DONE - Added hasCourseAccess check to ConnectCoursePage.tsx. Free and Rooted users now see a locked screen with upgrade prompt. Nourished+ gets full access.

Task: Gate Parenting course behind Thriving tier
Details: DONE - Added hasCourseAccess check to ParentingCoursePage.tsx. Free, Rooted, and Nourished users now see a locked screen. Thriving plan gets full access.

Task: Review and update Privacy Policy for NZ Privacy Act 2020
Details: DONE - Privacy Policy at /privacy-policy already covers: data collection, NZ Privacy Act 2020, user rights (access/correction/deletion), Stripe payment processing, no data selling, children privacy (18+). Contact email listed.

Task: Add health information disclaimer to app
Details: DONE - Disclaimer added to OnboardingFlow.tsx welcome screen. Also review /terms to ensure it references the disclaimer.

Task: Verify Refund Policy covers digital subscriptions
Details: DONE - Refund Policy at /refund-policy covers: free tier, monthly/annual subscriptions via Stripe, cancellation process, refund circumstances (accidental/technical/duplicate), how to request. NZ Consumer Guarantees Act compliant.

Task: Recruit 20-50 beta testers across iOS and Android
Details: Target NZ-based women aged 25-45 interested in cycle syncing, wellness, or mindfulness. Reach via: personal network, Facebook groups, Instagram DMs to followers and wellness communities.

Task: Send SIGNAL1MONTH coupon codes to all beta testers
Details: Send each tester their coupon code plus the onboarding DM template from 06-marketing-content.csv. Track in 02-beta-testers.csv spreadsheet. Create SIGNAL1MONTH coupon in Stripe first.

Task: Follow up with testers at Day 3, Day 14, Day 30
Details: Day 3: check they onboarded successfully. Day 14: ask for NPS score 1-10. Day 30: ask for written testimonial and whether they would upgrade to paid. Track responses in 02-beta-testers.csv.

Task: Collect written testimonials from beta testers
Details: Ask testers who rate 9-10 NPS for a 2-3 sentence quote you can use on your website and App Store listing. These are invaluable for conversion.

Task: Create Instagram Business account for Signal
Details: Go to instagram.com > Settings > Switch to Professional Account > Business. Use email: contact@mindcast.co.nz or the brand email. Connect to a Facebook Page (required for ads later).

Task: Create TikTok Business account for Signal
Details: Go to tiktok.com > Sign up > Business account. Use the brand email. TikTok is currently the best organic reach platform for wellness content targeting women 25-40.

Task: Post first 3 Instagram launch posts
Details: Use the captions and hashtags from 06-marketing-content.csv. Post order: 1. App launch announcement. 2. Educational carousel about cycle syncing. 3. Day in the life Reel.

Task: Post first TikTok videos
Details: Use the scripts from 06-marketing-content.csv. Start with the founder story video and the things that changed my life format. Film on iPhone, edit in CapCut.

Task: DM 10 NZ wellness influencers using gifted access template
Details: Search Instagram for #nzwellness #nzwomen #cyclesyncing. DM 10 accounts with 5k-100k followers using the Influencer DM Template in 06-marketing-content.csv. Offer BETA2025 code.

Task: Publish Product Hunt launch
Details: Create product page at producthunt.com using the copy in 06-marketing-content.csv. Launch on a Tuesday or Wednesday for best results. Share in NZ startup communities on launch day.

Task: Set up Google Analytics or PostHog funnel tracking
Details: PostHog is already installed. Add VITE_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN to Vercel env vars. Then set up a funnel in PostHog: Homepage > Signup > First journal entry > Subscription.

Task: Submit app to NZ startup communities
Details: Submit to: StartupNZ newsletter, Lightning Lab alumni network, Hnry community, NZ Tech community on LinkedIn. These audiences understand and support NZ-built products.

Task: Verify production environment variables are set
Details: Check Vercel (or your host) has all required env vars: VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, VITE_SENTRY_DSN, VITE_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN. These should NOT be committed to GitHub.

Task: Set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY in Supabase edge function secrets
Details: Supabase Dashboard > Settings > Vault > Secrets. Confirm STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET are present. These power the stripe-webhook edge function.

Task: Commit and push all recent code fixes
Details: Ready to commit: Lovable URL removed from capacitor.config.ts, PostHog env var fix, health disclaimer in onboarding, course gates on Connect and Parenting, /brand and /animation-poc protected, console.error cleanup. Run git status to review.

Task: Verify custom domain is configured on hosting
Details: Confirm signal.mindcast.co.nz resolves to your production app with HTTPS. Test in incognito browser. Check SSL certificate is valid and not expiring soon.

Task: Test app on real Android device before launch
Details: Install APK or use Play Store Internal Testing on a real Android phone. Test: login, cycle tracking, journal AI, membership upgrade, push notifications.

Task: Test app on real iPhone before launch
Details: Use TestFlight to install on a real iPhone. Test same flows as Android. Pay attention to safe area insets and bottom navigation on iPhone with notch/island.

Task: Check all 39 edge functions are deployed
Details: Supabase Dashboard > Edge Functions. Verify all 39 functions show green status and recent successful invocations. Any red status needs investigation.
